summary: Empire Earth entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Empire Earth

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GOG Gold Edition on modern Windows

primary.why: Empire Earth is a Windows RTS, and GOG's Gold Edition is the best current legal route because it packages the game for modern Windows and includes preservation-program compatibility work. The original CD is the historical route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GOG Gold Edition on Windows 10/11, include The Art of Conquest expansion if doing a complete route, and record compatibility wrapper, resolution, and multiplayer/lobby availability.

all_releases.reason: skip: historical route, but modern compatibility is better through GOG.

all_releases.fidelity: Official expansion content included in the Gold route.
all_releases.reason: primary: include for a complete archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern Windows preservation build with GOG compatibility updates.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current legal and compatibility route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: GOG Gold Edition covers the practical modern route and expansion content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a remaster. Record GOG compatibility wrapper/version and expansion state.

entries.title: Empire Earth II
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with expansion/patch/multiplayer state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC build with exact official/unofficial patch and expansion state documented

primary.version: Original PC release with official/unofficial patch state documented
primary.why: Empire Earth II is a PC RTS whose current preservation depends on patch state, expansion ownership, and unofficial fixes/multiplayer replacement after GameSpy shutdown. The Art of Supremacy expansion is related but should be labeled separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC release with final official patch and intended unofficial patch state. Record version, expansion ownership, widescreen/fix state, campaign/skirmish, civilization, multiplayer lobby/server state, and whether Empire Earth II: The Art of Supremacy was included.

secondary.platform: Empire Earth II: The Art of Supremacy
secondary.what_to_play: Include only when documenting the expanded route.

all_releases.platform: The Art of Supremacy expansion / unofficial patch route
all_releases.fidelity: Expanded/fixed route with replacement multiplayer options.
all_releases.reason: primary: document if using complete patched route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Unofficial patches and replacement multiplayer improve current play but alter preservation state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Empire Earth III; label expansion scope.

entries.title: Empire Earth III
entries.definitive_edition: Owned Windows PC release with exact patch and compatibility state documented

emulation.emulator: Windows VM/compatibility layer only if native play fails
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Final PC build with exact patch, fix, and multiplayer state documented

primary.version: Original PC release with patch/compatibility state documented
primary.why: Empire Earth III is a PC RTS entry whose current preservation depends on ownership, patch state, compatibility fixes, and the post-GameSpy multiplayer situation. It should remain separate from Empire Earth and Empire Earth II despite the shared series.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PC copy with final patch and compatibility fixes. Record version, source, OS/renderer/resolution fixes, campaign/skirmish faction, difficulty, multiplayer/lobby state, and whether unofficial fixes were used.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Old PC availability, compatibility fixes, and multiplayer replacement state define the current archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Empire Earth I/II or their expansion routes.
